title: Name a value that never changes

public.title: Declare a fixed rate
public.prompt: A tax rate stays the same for the whole cart. Which keyword should declare it?

hints.text: The value is written once and then only read.
Pick the keyword that forbids reassigning the name.

explanations.workedExample: const names a value that cannot be reassigned. TAX_RATE is read by the total, never changed, so const says that to the reader.
explanations.practice: Declare a DISCOUNT constant that holds 0.1.

secret.narration: A tax rate is set once and then read many times. const makes that promise in the code, so nobody can reassign it by accident.

public.title: Make the rate a constant
public.prompt: TAX_RATE should never be reassigned. Type the keyword that declares it.

hints.text: It is the same keyword you chose in the last question.

explanations.workedExample: Swapping let for const turns a value that could change into one that cannot. The line still reads the same otherwise.
explanations.practice: Change var API_URL to a constant.

secret.narration: let allows reassignment. Changing one word to const stops that, and the rest of the file stays the same.
